purpose: Teach: ジャーナル/出社/引き受ける/役立っ/開場/引き締め/スワップ/手動

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、業界ジャーナル、私、必死に、読んだもんだ、覚えてる、お父さんの代、本当に、苦労してたんだ。
lines.en: When the company started, I remember reading industry journals desperately — those were the years your grandfather worked so hard.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Slight weight on the memory. Slow pace — he's looking backward into time. Warm but unsentimental. A grandfather passing something forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、創業当時、出社時間、誰よりも、早かったって、聞いてます、お母さんから、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I've heard from Mother that Father arrived earlier than anyone else in those founding days. It was really something.
lines.style: Respectful, steady tone. Not performing reverence — genuinely listening and responding. A son acknowledging what his father built. Clear-eyed, present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 責任を、引き受ける覚悟、私、創業時に、決めたんだ、若い君にも、見習って欲しい、本当に。
lines.en: That's why I decided right from the start to take on responsibility with real resolve. I want you to learn that same thing, even now.
lines.style: Quieter intensity. Not commanding — teaching. Lands firmly on the word for resolve. Slight pause before the request. An elder's weight, gently handed over.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの教え、社員、本当に、役立っております、感謝しております、創業者として、私たちにも。
lines.en: Yes. Father's teachings have truly been helpful to our staff, and I'm grateful for that — as someone carrying on what he founded, I feel that weight.
lines.style: Formal but not stiff. Sincere gratitude underneath the courtesy. A slight pause before naming the responsibility. Speaking both to his father and to the role itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業祭の開場、私の代から、地域の方々、お招きしてきた、伝統、続けてくれ、これからも。
lines.en: That's why since my time, I've invited the local community to our founding day celebration — that's a tradition I want you to keep going.
lines.style: Directive but not sharp. A legacy being passed — he's not asking, but the tone holds affection underneath the instruction. Measured pace. Looks ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。経営の引き締め、創業期、お父さん、何度も、経験したんですよね、覚えてますか、お父さん?
lines.en: Yes. During the founding period, Father had to tighten management so many times. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Gentle questioning. Respectful but genuine — he's not asking permission, he's inviting his father to witness that he was paying attention. Warm precision in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 海外取引、お父さんの代から、為替スワップ、活用してきたんだぞ、戦略の一つだ、覚えておけよ。
lines.en: We've been using foreign exchange strategies since your grandfather's time — currency swaps were one of our tools. Remember that.
lines.style: Sharp focus. The teaching moment. Matter-of-fact delivery of something important — not humble, not bragging. A fact that matters. Lands the instruction lightly but firmly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業時、すべて手動で、業務、こなしていたお父さんの姿、本当に、尊敬しております、私、お父さん。
lines.en: Yes. Watching Father handle everything by hand in those early days — I really respect that. The simplicity of it, the sheer effort.
lines.style: Warmth deepening toward the end. A son truly seeing his father across time. Slower, more vulnerable than before. Genuine admiration, not dutiful. Quiet close.
